spans.text: After a long while following Ange's departure, 45 finally turns her gaze toward the juvenile Isomers.
Anna is talking to the other children, trying to comfort them and put them at ease.
45 skims through the information that Ange just gave her, then as if suddenly struck by a realization, she looks up.
She walks over to Gr G11, who's lying perfectly still on the floor, then kneels down and pinches her on the cheeks.
Ow-ow-ow-ow-ow!
I knew all along that you've recovered. Now get up.
416 would kick your ass if she saw you like this.
Oh... So you knew.
I just didn't expose you because I had more important things to do.
S...sorry about what happened. I had to paralyze her because she wouldn't stop moving.
As Anna is comes closer, Gr G11 quickly darts behind 45.
Hey, aren't you being way too skittish?
You weren't the one she paralyzed!
I thought I was done for when the Nyto got me...
My name is Anna, I'm not a Nyto!
So she says. Now why don't you greet her nicely?
You heard Ange – this is our very important client.
Ugh... Al...alright.
H...h...hello...
That forced smile looks really gross. Please don't make her do that...
What a pity, I'm kinda enjoying this myself.
45, we're here!
Any of the doors can be flung open just like that – you're amazing, 45!
Oh, you're still alive, Gr G11.
Of course I'm still alive!
What's this difference in treatment? I was fighting very hard too, you know...
Fighting while lying sprawled on the floor?
Hm... That also counts, right...?
Damn shame, I thought I could finally be rid of both nuisances.
My, my, there you go again, 416.
Who was it that ran dozens of laps outside trying to find the controls?
I just wanted to complete my mission ASAP!
By the way, these children...
These are the test subjects in the lab. Ange wants us to bring them back with us safely.
So they must be the Nyto signals we detected before.
I would agree... But since they're standing right next to 45 and Gr G11, they probably aren't hostile?
Not to mention how cute they look.
Hm... Your teammates are just as weird as you. Are you some kind of weirdo squad?
Can't be helped. We are indeed an oddball squad made up of a bunch of oddball Dolls.
Attention, all echelons! Would all T-Dolls still capable of fighting please make for the Commander's position! The Commander is being surrounded by the enemy and requires immediate assistance!
I repeat – would all T-Dolls still capable of fighting please make for the Commander's position!
The Commander is engaging the enemy in person?
Then Griffin's situation must be very dire. If the Commander is killed, Griffin will also collapse, and that would be catastrophic.
Miss Kalina, this is Squad 404. We can provide support, please give us the Commander's location.
404?! That's wonderful! I'm sending you the coordinates right now!
Received.
Also, Ange has handed us a group of juvenile Isomers she found in the lab. Some of my squad members will be escorting them to you. Please don't open fire when they arrive.
Juvenile Isomers...?
Understood, I'll share this information with our forces!
Thanks. 404 out.
Looks like we'll have to split up.
9, you and Gr G11 take these Isomers and retreat behind Griffin's line of defense.
416, you and I will give the Commander some backup. Questions?
Good, all in accord, as I expected. Then let's get moving.
